title: Layout shell simplify — friendlier IA for notebook learning
description: Simplify Syntaxia mobile/desktop shell and page IA for a friendlier notebook learning UX. Unify footer to 4 tabs with guest-aware Account/Login; slim home to hero + primary CTA + few featured tracks (full catalog stays on /tracks); reduce chrome competition (one mobile lesson-nav entry); restructure lesson page vertical rhythm (read → practice → pager/complete → notes); make progress/notes summary hubs. Keep Mintlify desktop sidebar+TOC. No backend changes.
